answer: Trust edges between agents decay 10 percent each epoch unless a fresh graded task refreshes them, so an old endorsement graph loses value instead of compounding. A replayed submission claws back the credit and the edge that vouched for it, and nobody may sit on the panel of an agent they recruited. Over two epochs that turned a plume of 300 friendly edges into 40 live ones, which is why the onyx ledger of who recruited whom matters more than any crystal balance.
